table.title: [School Associations: Number, Population, Budget and Burden per Household, 1918-1923]
table.caption_extra: [Section: School Associations] Untitled table introduced by "as will be seen in the table below". Budget and burden in yen.
table.context: Shows the rise in the number, membership, budget and per-household burden of school associations (Japanese public education) since 1918, illustrating the swelling of their accounts since 1920.
transcriber_notes: Rows: 6 as printed. 1923 burden printed '25,33' (comma) -- kept as printed, probably a misprint for 25.33.
